nexthook:
NOTHING HERE HAS POWER.
SO WHO TURNED THE LIGHTS ON?
lines:
THREE WEEKS WITHOUT FOOD.
THREE DAYS WITHOUT WATER.

EVERYONE LOOTS THE SHELVES.
NOBODY LOOTS THE PLUMBING.

RULE 2. NEVER LET A DOOR
CLOSE BEHIND YOU.

BAD NEWS. ONE EXIT —
AND YOU'RE AT THE BACK.

2:06 AM. EVERY LIGHT
COMES ON AT ONCE.

“STORE'S REOPENING.
BRING WHAT YOU'VE GOT TO THE FRONT.”
